title.jcr:title: Partner with AbbVie Japan to bring your late-stage asset to patients in Japan

text.text:
AbbVie invites biopharma companies with late‑stage assets to explore Japan-only and Japan-inclusive regional partnering opportunities.

Through focused 1:1 meetings with AbbVie Japan, we aim to advance discussions on Japan‑specific licensing opportunities aligned with AbbVie’s strategic priorities.

Scroll down to learn what makes Japan attractive for overseas biopharma and how AbbVie Japan can help you unlock the opportunity.
